meta.name: llmskill
meta.description: Sync skills from tinywasm/devflow/skills to all installed LLM agents (Claude, Gemini). Run after creating or modifying any SKILL.md file in devflow/skills/.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 同步本地技能文件到所有已安装的LLM代理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在本地开发技能并需要自动同步到多个AI代理
copy.tagline_en: Sync local skill files to all installed LLM agents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop skills locally and need automatic sync to multiple AI agents

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会读取你本地同步的技能文件（SKILL.md），并根据其中的描述决定何时应用该技能。技能文件为只读上下文，Claude 不会主动运行 llmskill。
howto.when: 当你创建或修改了 tinywasm/devflow/skills/ 下的 SKILL.md 文件后，在终端运行 llmskill 命令时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个名为“代码审查”的技能文件。
运行 llmskill 同步所有技能。
say.note: Claude 不会执行命令，但会指导你如何操作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reads locally synced skill files (SKILL.md) and decides when to apply them based on their descriptions. Skill files are read-only context; Claude does not run llmskill itself.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you create or modify a SKILL.md file under tinywasm/devflow/skills/ and then run the llmskill command in the terminal.

say_en.text: Help me write a skill file named 'Code Review'.
Run llmskill to sync all skills.
say_en.note: Claude won't execute the command but will guide you on how to do it.
